subject: SSO & SCIM cutover governance for Private control plane: role mapping and handoff
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@omnihealth.org>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: SSO & SCIM cutover governance for Private control plane: role mapping and handoff

Carlos — thanks again for the time today. As discussed, OmniHealth will be moving the Redwood Private control plane (VPC deployment) to use your corporate IdP for SSO + SCIM provisioning. To keep the cutover low-risk we want to agree a narrow scope and a rollback plan.

Attached: connor-20270710-role-matrix-v1.xlsx (role matrix draft).

Primary asks from our side to make the next week productive:
- Can you confirm the IdP SAML metadata and an SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated preference?
- Confirm SCIM write permissions: will your IdP allow group membership updates for us to read only, or will we be allowed to write group assignments?
- Any required assertion attributes beyond email/name (e.g., employeeNumber, dept, delegationRole)? We propose mapping Redwood roles: admin, infra-ops, model-admin, auditor.
- Network note: dev will need temporary egress to your IdP and SCIM endpoint from the private control plane (we'll list IPs). Is opening a short-lived outbound rule acceptable?

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Day 0: exchange SAML metadata and SCIM endpoint details
- Day 2: staging test with canary tenant + pilot group of 3 users
- Day 4: validation, rollback window, then full sync (SCIM)

If that looks right I'll coordinate engineering to create the staging connector and provide the exact IPs and CSR for cert pinning.

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

--
Attachment: connor-20270710-role-matrix-v1.xlsx (roles/privileges spreadsheet)

Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SSO & SCIM cutover governance for Private control plane: role mapping and handoff

Connor — thanks, this looks straightforward. A few answers inline:
- We prefer SP-initiated SAML for the control plane portal. I'll attach our current SAML metadata.
- SCIM: our IdP (Okta + custom proxy) will allow write access to group membership for external apps but only for a scoped service account. We can create that account for Redwood.
- Assertions: we can provide email, displayName, employeeNumber, and groups. We cannot provide manager or costCenter via SAML at this time.
- Network: short-lived outbound rule is fine — we ask that you document the IPs and that Redwood rotate any long-lived creds.

Attached: omni-saml-metadata.xml, scim-attribute-allowlist.csv

Carlos Mendez
Senior IT Architect, OmniHealth

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SSO & SCIM cutover governance for Private control plane: role mapping and handoff

Thanks Carlos — helpful. Quick technical notes from the infra side:

1) SAML attributes: we will consume email (NameID), displayName, employeeNumber. For authoritative role assignment we recommend SCIM group -> Redwood role mapping (SCIM groups carry group.name). If Omni cannot write groups, we will read group membership only and evaluate a manual mapping fallback.

2) SCIM permissions: ideal flow is Redwood service account with write:Members, write:Groups limited to the "redwood-scim-connector" scope. We'll need the service account's JTI and an X509 cert thumbprint for mTLS if your proxy supports it.

3) Network: please open outbound rule for these IPs (staging then prod): 34.211.121.45, 34.211.121.46 (staging); 52.24.88.12, 52.24.88.13 (prod). We'll limit egress to port 443 and retry backoff to avoid spikes.

4) Rollback: if the full sync introduces unexpected role escalations we'll pause SCIM write and run a reverse sync from our snapshot. To make that safe, please give us read-only access to current group -> user mapping for a 48-hour pre-cutover window so we can build a deterministic snapshot.

Attached: dev-devices-scim-mapping.txt (field mapping notes).

- Dev Patel
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

1) Today (14-Jul): Redwood to upload staging connector image and provide precise IPs + CSR for mTLS. (Owner: Connor)
2) Omni to create scoped SCIM service account and provide credentials + SAML metadata (Owner: Carlos)

4) Post-pilot: validate no role escalations, run a randomized 50-user sync in staging. If OK, schedule prod sync with a 2-hour rollback window. (Owner: Dev)

Action items for Omni: share the service account JTI and cert thumbprint by EOD 7/16 and confirm the NDA amendment status.
Action items for Redwood: share the Drive link with staging runbook and a short checklist for the canary.
